title: Recency-Based Confidence Scoring Bug Fix
description: Discovered that async_prep.py was calling calculate_confidence_level(category, level) instead of calculate_confidence_level(entry_age_minutes). Fixed by updating all three entry types (OperatorIntention, ResearchTopic, DecisionPoint) to use recency parameter. Tool now correctly outputs ~95% [HIGH CONFIDENCE] for fresh entries (age 0 min), matching design spec.
